title: Vercel Container Registry now supports 2 GB compressed image layers
summary_en: Vercel Container Registry now supports compressed image layers of up to 2 GB each, up from 500 MB, the total image size limit stays 15 GB. The registry works with standard workflows like docker push , docker pull , and docker tag , and pushing an image creates the repository on the fly. Repositories can be made public for read-only pull access by any Vercel team, or shared with specific teams up to 100 from the dashboard or with vercel vcr permissions .
